chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Hammad ibn Zayd, from 'Abd Allah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:

Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام led us in salat in the mosque of Banu Kahil. He recited aloud twice, 'In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,' performed qunut in the fajr prayer, and gave one salutation toward the direction of the qiblah.

key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ: the basmalah recited at the beginning of the surah
key_terms.سَلَّمَ: gave the concluding salutation of salat
key_terms.صَلَّى: performed salat or led the prayer
key_terms.قَنَتَ: performed qunut, the supplicatory standing in prayer

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام perform salat in regard to the basmalah, qunut in fajr, and the final salutation?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام performed salat, mentioning audible recitation of the basmalah, qunut in the fajr prayer, and a single salutation facing the qiblah. It is significant for discussions of the practical manner and sunnah details of prayer in Shia fiqh.
